description: This file is a server-side route for a SvelteKit application managing invoice templates. It includes a load function to fetch and transform invoice template data from a backend API, and actions to create, update, and delete templates through API calls.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Fetches invoice templates from the backend API, applies filters, and transforms data for the frontend. Throws an error if organization context is missing or if the API request fails.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Handles creation of a new invoice template via POST request to the API. Extracts form data, compiles template information, and sends the data. Returns success or error status.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Handles updating an existing invoice template via PUT request. Validates template ID, extracts form data, and updates the backend API.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Handles deletion of an invoice template via DELETE request. Validates template ID and communicates with the API.
